chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The leftover water of a menstruating woman may be drunk from, but wudu (ablution) should not be performed with it.

key_terms.سُؤْرُ: leftover water or drink remaining after someone has used it
key_terms.وَلَا تَتَوَضَّأُ: and you should not perform wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: Can one drink from the leftover water of a menstruating woman or use it for wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the leftover water used by a menstruating woman. It indicates that drinking from it is permitted, while using it for wudu (ablution) is not permitted in this narration.
